description: Source code for the VoiceWakeSettings SwiftUI view, which manages voice wake configuration, microphone and language selection, trigger words, and related functionalities in the application.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for configuring voice wake features, including microphone selection, trigger words, language settings, and sound alerts.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Represents an audio input device with a unique ID and name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: Represents a trigger word entry with a unique UUID and string value.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the app state into local trigger entries.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Syncs local trigger entries back to the app state.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word by its UUID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake testing process.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Creates a UI component to select or play a chime sound.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom audio file for the chime.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets a selected chime and plays it.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts command text from a transcript based on trigger words.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the stored microphone name based on the selection.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a microphone device list refresh.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly name for a locale.

methods.name: restartMeter
methods.description: Restarts the microphone level meter and updates the UI.
